items.title: Butch Miles interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: Well my first big influence was Gene Krupa. He was like the biggest influence on me. Right at the beginning I was a huge fan of Gene’s.

ctx.x: Who were some of the influential drummers that you listened to that you liked at that time?

Well my first big influence was Gene Krupa. He was like the biggest influence on me. Right at the beginning I was a huge fan of Gene’s. I loved everything about him. I loved his style and his sound, and his flair, his showmanship, and the way he would really put over a great drum solo — even add that little extra pizzazz that just made me say “Wow.” Because a lot of times you see some wonderful musicians and they just look like they can’t wait for the next taxi out of town. They’re not enjoying themselves or…
From that list it’s almost as if you went backwards in first listening to like Krupa and then listening to guys that came even before him.

items.title: Butch Miles interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 9, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: my very first hero of all time was Gene Krupa. So I knew where Benny was going on some of those old, old, old, old, old tunes, and I’d go there.

ctx.x: Well I didn’t play per se behind Frank. We did work with Frank Sinatra on a number of occasions. Frank had his own drummer, Irv Cottler, the great Irv Cottler, and I was able to hang out with Irv a little bit, and actually met Sinatra. We had a little chat one night

backstage which was just delightful. So I was in the area. I could see what was happening. And that was great. It was scary enough being around their — on Broadway, it was Count Basie, Frank Sinatra, and Ella Fitzgerald. And then we went out on a little tour in a couple of cities, same group. Then we went over to the Palladium and we did a couple of weeks at the Palladium in London with Frank Sinatra, Sarah Vaughan and Count Basie. And then we did one which actually had me scared all up and down, we did a Royal…
